method: Independent inline Python binary64 CSV recomputation using NumPy/SciPy; no import or execution of the producer/reference scripts. Exact Fraction saved-clock reconstruction, fixed-material center18 reaggregation, independently assembled finite-Kw and paper-limit eigenfunction sums, and initial-cloud radial mean/shell/stress quadrature. This is not a second BI4 parser.

bounded_hash_audit.coverage: Producer 23 inputs and 7 artifacts; all four native checks' source manifests/artifacts and three fresh reducer logs; all manifest non-catalog inputs; adopted nu030 parent check/manifest; reducer build's 164 inputs, compiler, executable and log. Root records above were separately hashed for this peer seal.

numerical_agreement.peak_time_difference_explanation: Independent optimization used legacy Tv rather than physical tau. The flat maximum has the same pressure to binary64 rounding; this nanosecond optimizer difference is not a simulation timing error. Published metric times were not rewritten.

reference_contract.tau_definition: actual saved time minus 2^-7 s, never shifted to ramp end or first drained frame
reference_contract.native_sampled_peak_window: legacy Tv >= .005 through each actual endpoint, with adjacent saved times retained
reference_contract.continuous_peak_window: independent search in predeclared legacy Tv .005 through .5
reference_contract.shell_definition: initial r0 >= a - 2*h, initial-volume weighted inward radius change; not vertical settlement or displacement projected on the initial radial vector
reference_contract.center_std_definition: population scatter across the fixed 18 material points, not a confidence interval

limitations: This peer reaggregated exported fixed18 data and recomputed references; it did not re-read all raw BI4 fields, all raw stress/load samples, or the roughly 6 GB trajectories.

Nu=.30 is an explicitly adopted previously audited full native series. Its symplectic_dt_s column is the declared actual fixed-step/runtime-clock contract, not a newly decoded all-frame raw SymplecticDtPre series. Historical EXE/DLL identity remains unproven.

The generic reducer permits an initial missing dterror default, but the separate identity peer actually decoded initial and final raw dterror presence for all four inputs; this input-specific proof is inherited, not a new generic API guarantee.

Finite-Kw quasistatic theory, paper incompressible point-center theory and fixed18 finite-radius sampling are distinct reference contracts. No full-cycle half-step, equilibrium, restart, continuum 1% or general physical acceptance is asserted.

Remaining startup transition, output-resolution peak-time bias and late residual pressure are retained, not smoothed or excluded. In particular nu=.1 final 133.758 Pa is remaining pressure, not a 133.758 Pa error.
